title: Sequence log-probs, the KL-regularised optimum, and best-of-n
brief: Score whole responses as masked sums of token log-probabilities, build the KL-regularised optimal policy in closed form and again token by token with soft backward induction, and measure exactly how far best-of-n moves from the reference.
hints: token_logprobs is logits minus logsumexp(logits) along the last axis, read off with np.take_along_axis(logits, tokens[..., None], axis=-1). Subtract the row maximum before exponentiating.
In sequence_logprob, 0 * -inf is nan. Use np.where(mask, token_logps, 0.0) before summing over the last axis.
kl_optimal_policy is a softmax of ref_logps + rewards / beta. kl_regularised_objective needs np.where(probs > 0, ...) so a zero probability contributes nothing to the KL.

soft_token_policy walks t from T - 1 down to 0. At each step, z = ref_cond_logps[t] + v_next / beta, v = beta * logsumexp(z, axis=-1), and log pi = z - v[..., None] / beta. Start with v_next = rewards.
For best_of_n_probs, sort by reward, take the cumulative reference mass F, and give the i-th sorted response F_i ** n - F_{i-1} ** n. Scatter back with out[order] = ...
